description: This file defines the Event interface for all events emitted by the Ditto framework. It specifies methods for retrieving event type, revision, timestamp, metadata, and converting the event to JSON. It also includes nested class for JSON field definitions, sharing schema details.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A base interface for all event types emitted by Ditto, parameterized by the implementing class type. Provides methods for accessing event attributes, schema version, and JSON representation. Defines constants and nested classes for JSON schema fields.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type qualifier of the event.

methods.name: getImplementedSchemaVersion
methods.description: Defaults to returning the schema version from headers or the latest schema version if unavailable.

methods.name: setRevision
methods.description: Creates a copy of the event with the specified revision.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the event's timestamp.

methods.name: getMetadata
methods.description: Returns an Optional containing the event's metadata.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Converts the event to a JsonObject including non-hidden fields.
